level.why: 三人互動題，需描述舉杯動作，並搭配人數與桌上物品位置等細節。

image_prompt: A realistic photograph of three people raising glasses at a dining table. Natural lighting, 4:3 landscape orientation, sharp focus, clean and simple composition, in the style of a TOEIC Part 1 photo. Composition: Two or three people clearly interacting with each other or with objects, with clear positional relationships (at, on, beside, in front of, next to). No text, signs, logos or brand names anywhere; no readable screens or papers; no celebrities; at most 4 people, with natural proportions, normal hands and fingers, and simple, clearly visible hand actions.
visible_facts: Two women and one man are sitting around a wooden dining table.
All three are raising wine glasses toward each other and smiling.
A plate of bread is on the table in front of the woman on the left.
Plates of food, water glasses, a glass jug and folded napkins are on the table.
Wooden shelves with potted plants are on the wall behind them.

pool.t: Three people are raising their glasses at the table.
pool.zh: 三個人正在餐桌前舉起酒杯。
pool.why: 正解：兩女一男在餐桌前舉起酒杯互相碰杯，與畫面相符。

pool.t: The three people are sitting around a wooden table.
pool.zh: 這三個人正圍坐在一張木桌旁。
pool.why: 正解：三人分坐在木製餐桌的周圍，與畫面相符。

pool.t: There is a plate of bread on the table.
pool.why: 正解：桌子前方有一個盤子，上面放著麵包，與畫面相符。

pool.t: They are tossing a salad together at the table.
pool.zh: 他們正在桌邊一起拌沙拉。
pool.why: tossing 與 toasting（碰杯）音近，但畫面中沒有沙拉，他們是在舉杯。

pool.t: A waiter is pouring wine into the glasses.
pool.zh: 一名服務生正在把酒倒進杯子裡。
pool.why: 畫面中沒有服務生，也沒有人在倒酒。

pool.t: A basket of fruit is on the table.
pool.why: 桌上有盤子、麵包、水壺與杯子，沒有水果籃。

pool.t: The man is handing a glass to the woman.
pool.zh: 這名男子正把一個杯子遞給女子。
pool.why: handing 與 holding 是近義動作干擾；男子是自己握著杯子舉杯，沒有遞給別人。

pool.t: The woman on the right is cutting the bread.
pool.zh: 右邊的女子正在切麵包。
pool.why: 右邊的女子正舉著酒杯，沒有在切麵包。

pool.t: Both women are standing beside the table.
pool.zh: 兩名女子都站在桌子旁邊。
pool.why: 三個人都是坐著，沒有站著。

pool.t: Four people are sitting at the table.
pool.why: 畫面中只有三個人，不是四個人。

pool.t: The bread is on the shelf behind them.
pool.zh: 麵包放在他們後面的架子上。
pool.why: 麵包在前方桌上的盤子裡，後方架子上放的是盆栽與器皿。

pool.t: They are celebrating a promotion at the restaurant.
pool.zh: 他們正在餐廳慶祝升職。
pool.why: 畫面只看得出三人舉杯，無法確認原因是升職或地點是餐廳，這是過度推論。

vocab.col: a plate of bread / dinner plate
fresh bread / a slice of bread

issues: 圖片場景看起來像家中或鄉村風格的餐廳（石牆、木桌、架上盆栽），不易確定是餐廳；若要嚴格符合 restaurant，建議確認或重新出圖。
三人皆在舉杯，動作相同，因此分數取 650 主要依人數與位置細節。
圖中無可讀文字或商標；手部與酒杯畫面自然，未見明顯瑕疵。
